source: Typical values, general geotechnical references (Craig, Bowles). Not transcribed from a specific site investigation or the office's own material specification -- confirm against the actual specified fill before use, and prefer a project-specific SoilInput over a preset wherever a geotechnical report exists.

presets.name: clean_sand
presets.description: Clean, well-graded sand or sandy gravel, compacted

presets.name: silty_sand
presets.description: Sand with a significant silt fraction, compacted

presets.name: gravel
presets.description: Clean crushed rock or gravel, compacted

presets.name: stiff_clay
presets.description: Stiff clay, drained -- small drained cohesion intercept retained deliberately, do not increase without a site-specific test

presets.name: site_won_fill
presets.description: Site-won fill, moisture-conditioned and compacted -- the most variable of these presets; treat as a placeholder pending a compaction/CBR record for the actual material
